text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente returned to the waiting room 
after finishing the race.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
As long as that is clear, there is nothing 
left to do but struggle forward.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If 100 isn't enough, I'll simply train at 
200.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: That is the only thing I can do right now.
choice_data_list:
Even in tough times, you're staying true 
to yourself.

Even in tough times, you're staying true

I'll make sure you seize the title of 
strongest. Even from here, without fail!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. The fire within me shall never 
be extinguished.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
What we need now is to stoke that fire 
even higher.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: If only I can do that—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes. I will claim victory, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
With those flames—I'll swallow everything 
whole...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Heh, it seems your resolve was just as 
strong as mine, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to ask you to intensify my 
training.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if it's harsher than any 
training I've ever done.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If it's for the sake of clawing my way 
back to the top, no hardship will ever 
faze me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I won't be holding back. You're sticking 
with me to the very end, Trainer.
